channel.title: GiveOwl – Concorsi a premi in Italia
channel.description: Ogni concorso rimanda al regolamento ufficiale dell’organizzatore. GiveOwl non raccoglie mai le tue partecipazioni.

item.title: SayBeam Black Friday iPhone 18 Pro Giveaway – SayBeam
item.description: Premio: One iPhone 18 Pro, 256 GB, unlocked, in the winner’s choice of Burgundy, Glacier Blue, Silver or Black (ARV $1,199). Scadenza: 30 novembre 2026. Free entry: email contact@saybeam.com with the subject line "iPhone 18 Pro Giveaway - Free Entry" and your full name, email address and country of residence (see section 4B of the rules). Orders on saybeam.com also earn entries, but no purchase is required and both methods have the same chance per entry. 18+ (or age of majority) wherever the giveaway is permitted; Canadian winners must answer a skill-testing question. Runs Nov 6 – Nov 30, 2026, 11:59:59 p.m. ET; drawing on or about Dec 3, 2026.

item.title: Kraken: A Christmas Call with Poldi – win a video call with Lukas Podolski – Kraken (Payward Ltd.)
item.description: Premio: Ten winners each get a place on a 30-minute group video call with Lukas Podolski in the week of December 15–19, 2026 (ARV $500 each, $5,000 total). Scadenza: 1 dicembre 2026. Complete the entry form on the promotion landing page with your name and email address. Free: no purchase, deposit, trade or other financial activity is required. One entry per person. 18+ (or age of majority) residing in the EEA, the United States (excl. Maine, New York, Florida, Puerto Rico), Canada (excl. Quebec) and other jurisdictions where Kraken services are available; residents of the UK, Australia and Switzerland are not eligible. Runs Nov 1 – Dec 1, 2026, 23:59 UTC; 10 winners drawn after the close. Canadian winners must answer a skill-testing question.

item.title: Quelli della Colazione «Babbo Natale Segreto 2026»: 2.000 set di palline natalizie – Ferrero Commerciale Italia
item.description: Premio: 2.000 set da 3 palline natalizie (instant win, valore 12 € l’uno; montepremi 24.000 €), da regalare a chi vuoi con un biglietto a indizi. Scadenza: 10 dicembre 2026. Registrati gratis (o accedi) su quellidellacolazione.it, entra nell’area del concorso e clicca «GIOCA ORA» tra le 9:00 e le 23:00. Una sola partecipazione. Maggiorenni, dall’Italia. Gratuito. Dal 2/11 al 10/12/2026

item.title: Win with FALKEN – Bike Giveaway: BULLS e-trail or carbon gravel bikes – SOKRATIV GmbH (with Dunlop Tyre Europe / BULLS / ZEG)
item.description: Premio: 1× BULLS Copperhead EVO AM 2 e-trail bike (RRP €4,999) and 3× BULLS Machete RX 1 carbon gravel bikes (RRP €1,999 each). Scadenza: 30 novembre 2026. Fill in the free participation form on win-with-falken.com, select a bike and confirm terms. No purchase of FALKEN tyres required. One entry per person. Open to residents 18+ in Belgium, Bulgaria, Netherlands, Luxembourg, Switzerland, Italy, Poland, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Czech Republic or Hungary. Closes Nov 30, 2026 at 18:00

item.title: Sandberg: Calendario dell'Avvento – dicembre 2026 – Sandberg A/S
item.description: Premio: Un concorso al giorno dietro ogni porta; premi 2026 non ancora pubblicati. Scadenza: 24 dicembre 2026. Dal 1 al 24 dicembre apri ogni giorno la porta su sandberg.it e partecipa al concorso del giorno. Serve un account Sandberg gratuito (16+). Nessun acquisto.

item.title: Marketsz Major Sweepstake: win an iPhone 18 Pro – Marketsz Inc.
item.description: Premio: One iPhone 18 Pro (ARV $890) plus 1 year of Marketsz membership. Scadenza: 31 dicembre 2026. Free entry: create a free Marketsz account to receive ballots, or enter by the free email method described in the official rules. Open worldwide where legal, 18+. Ends December 31, 2026

item.title: Vinci un magico viaggio a Londra – Colgate-Palmolive Commerciale S.r.l.

item.title: Leroy Merlin: «30 anni di… fare casa insieme», buoni fino a 300 € – Leroy Merlin

Gratuito; maggiorenni residenti in Italia o San Marino. Dal 6/10 al 9/11/2026; giuria ed estrazione entro il 10/12

item.title: Generali: Trova l'impronta! – Generali Italia

Dall'1/10/2026 al 31/5/2027

item.description: Premio: Not confirmed for 2026 (2025: daily prize draws with prizes that changed each day). 2025: answer the day's question and fill in the entry form; each door stays open 48 hours. 18+
